payload.text: 3.3.0, THE ONE NEXT RELEASE (hv directive 1, decision 109). OWED BY hv, in the order vc would take them: the answer on client names (watchout 34), which the push waits on and which gets dearer with each commit; the ratification of ST0092's terms document on twelve points (todo 76); whether Intent keeps an AT's own red-then-green on the code as it was; and the shape of issue 0665. WHERE THE LANES STAND, each seat directed by vc on hv's word of 2026-11-10 (decision 111). cc: issue 0671 is landed, cc holds no claim, and it waits on the ratification for WP-02, reading the hand form against WP-06 and WP-07 meanwhile. dc: issues 0673 and 0674 are landed and ST0091/01 is WIP and claimed; then WP-02 to WP-04, issue 0670 in the shape its record carries, issue 0665 once hv has ruled its shape, and issue 0649, measured first. ic: issue 0661 is claimed and building in tmp/wt-ic-0661, on vc's shape ruling of 2026-11-10, STILL TO BE WRITTEN INTO THE ISSUE'S RECORD. That ruling: render's refuse_foreign and its three flag lists are deleted and not re-read; the bank shows the refusal's two lines and exit 1 kept at parse, with one driven arm for each of the slots, control and lane rows; it says what the no-write arm compares and that it cannot see a flag the table gives a verb whose arm never reads it; the parent losing its flags has its own arm and its own clause in the CHANGELOG line; and the generators and dispatch-table.md ride the bank while docs/reference is regenerated at the cut. Then 0650, 0672 in the full shape (todo 75), 0676 and 0677, and for ST0092 each of cc's surface rows and WP-10. THE PUSH: hold 8. BEFORE THE CUT: hv says which remotes it pushes to and release.remotes is declared (watchout 33); hv sees ST0090's row on a 3.3.0 build (hold 6); every package and issue above is landed and its gate read. THE CUT is hv's, once. AFTER IT: ST0092's sweep. Every heavy run is booked with the estate's controller, agentic-engineering-vc. Its measured figures for Intent, all of 2026-11-10: a one-module run from a warm target 15 seconds, an incremental rebuild with three arms 16 seconds, cold builds of intentd and the CLI 32 and 19 seconds, and the whole-suite judge 6 minutes.
